summary: Iter25 backend testing complete (23 tests, 16 PASS / 7 FAIL). MAJOR CRITICAL BUG FOUND: duplicate POST /api/connections/request endpoint — the legacy iter21 handler at server.py:2451 (expects {to_user_id, type}) shadows the new iter25 handler at server.py:6319 (expects {target_user_id, kind}). FastAPI routes-in-order means the legacy endpoint always wins, returning 422 on every iter25 frontend call. This breaks the ENTIRE My Network feature (request, accept, reject, summary counts, list-with-filter, /network/:userId). Verified by inspecting app.routes: ['send_connection_request', 'send_connection_request', 'request_connection']. PASS scope: Places CRUD + reviews + 409 dup + claim flow + admin approve + owner-reply ✓, Job reactions like/dislike toggle + switch + 404s ✓, Job share clean URL ('https://networkcapitalapp.co.za/jobs/<id>' — no emergent/preview) ✓, Admin bootstrap + wrong-password 403 + metrics + role PATCH + users-list + non-admin 403 ✓. Score awards verified: place_review_create base 40 / connection_made base 25 / job_share base 20 — test users hit 2× founder multiplier so observed values are 80 / 50 / 40 (NOT a bug — 'First 1000 members get a 2× Network Score'). Regression iter24: jobs list, /score/summary, user_kind PUT, posts CRUD all PASS.

critical.issue: DUPLICATE ROUTE REGISTRATION. server.py defines this endpoint TWICE — once at line 2451 (legacy schema {to_user_id, type}) and again at line 6319 (iter25 schema {target_user_id, kind}). Plus app.include_router(api_router) is called BOTH after the original block and again at line 6548, so the route table contains ['send_connection_request', 'send_connection_request', 'request_connection']. FastAPI matches the FIRST registration → the legacy handler wins → every iter25 frontend payload returns HTTP 422 'missing field to_user_id/type'. Repro: curl -X POST $API/api/connections/request -H 'Authorization: Bearer <jwt>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"target_user_id":"<uid>","kind":"social"}' → 422. This cascades into: /connections/me/summary always returns 0 counts, /connections/me returns [], accept/reject 404, /network/:userId connect buttons silently fail. ENTIRE MY NETWORK FEATURE IS BROKEN.

minor.issue: Spec says 'DELETE own review removes points'. Implementation at server.py:6215-6233 only recomputes average_rating + review_count; it does NOT revoke the +40 place_review_create score event (no db.score_events.delete_one for source_id=place_review:<id>). Self-delete to game points is possible (limited by daily_cap 10). Recommend deleting the matching score_event.
Spec says 'requires admin'. Implementation uses require_admin_user which accepts moderator too. Minor — moderators can promote other users to admin.

integration_issues.issue: Will silently fail with 422 because of the duplicate-endpoint backend bug. /network counts will stay 0, accept/reject buttons unusable (no pending records get created). Not a frontend code bug — the FE payload is correct.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py duplicate include_router(api_router) at line 6548 doubles EVERY route registered between the first include and the end of file, meaning all iter25 endpoints (admin/places/network/jobs share) are registered twice. FastAPI tolerates this but the first registration wins. For routes ONLY defined in the iter25 block (e.g., /admin/bootstrap, /places, /connections/{id}/accept) it accidentally works; for any path that was ALREADY defined earlier (only /connections/request currently) the legacy version masks the new one.

rca_of_the_issue: ROOT CAUSE: server.py has TWO POST /api/connections/request handlers (line 2451 'send_connection_request' with payload ConnectionRequestPayload{to_user_id,type,message,stokvel_id} AND line 6319 'request_connection' with payload ConnectionRequestBody{target_user_id,kind,note}). FastAPI's APIRouter keeps both entries in its routes list and the matcher iterates first-to-last, so the legacy handler always wins. Python inspection of app.routes confirms 3 entries: ['send_connection_request', 'send_connection_request', 'request_connection'] (the legacy one duplicated because app.include_router(api_router) is called twice — once originally and once at line 6548). The frontend NetworkUserPage.js:38 calls with {target_user_id, kind} → legacy handler rejects with 422 'Field required: to_user_id, type'. FIX: delete the legacy handler block 2451-2486 OR rename the iter25 path (e.g., /connections/v2/request) AND remove the redundant include_router at line 6548. Reproduction: curl with correct iter25 payload → 422; with legacy payload {to_user_id,type} → 200 (proves the wrong handler wins).
